findings.failure_scenario: Users will copy the documented command `apr serve ~/.cache/pacha/models/1e3be9285aea6923.safetensors` from the README and it will fail to run, because `apr serve` requires a subcommand (like `run` or `plan`) and does not accept a model path as its direct argument.
findings.source: crates/apr-cli/src/commands_enum.rs: Serve(ServeCommands) requires a subcommand (run or plan).
findings.summary: The documented `apr serve` command is incorrect and missing the required `run` subcommand.

findings.failure_scenario: Users reading the Quick Start guide will not learn about the user-friendly model alias feature (`apr pull qwen2.5-coder-1.5b`), as the clean example was removed and replaced entirely with an opaque, verbose cache path (`~/.cache/pacha/...`). This makes the tool appear more difficult to use.
findings.summary: The PR removes a valuable and idiomatic example of using model aliases, replacing it with a verbose cache path.
